rows.action: Goal scene time <15 minutes / Initiate rapid transport
rows.pems_text: Initiate transport. Goal scene time < 15 minutes: Symptoms less than 24 hours (or unknown) AND suspected LVO (RACE = 5 - 9) : Transport to the closest comprehensive stroke center as long as transport time is not increased by greater than 30 minutes. Symptoms greater than 24 hours OR low suspicion for LVO (RACE = 0 - 4): Transport to the closest stroke center.
